g.title: TI TMDS62LEVM Rev. B schematic sheet 29 — altiumts source

text.tspan: Shorting of multiple bootmode inputs together is not
recommended or allowed, since the bootmode inputs
have alternate functions that could be
configured after boot (can be set as outputs) Shorting
the bootmode pins directly to VCC or ground directly is
not recommended. Connect each of the bootmode pins
through separate resistor. Choose the bootmode resistor
value based on the use case (10K or similar)
The Ethernet interface (CPSW3G) interface supports 1.8V IO level only
Shorting of multiple bootmode inputs together is not recommended or allowed, since the bootmode inputs
have alternate functions that could be

configured after boot (can be set as outputs) Shorting the bootmode pins directly to VCC or ground directly is not recommended. Connect each of the bootmode pins through separate resistor. Choose the bootmode resistor value based on the use case (10K or similar)
